findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Squarefree/Basic.lean:117 supplies the multiplicity bound; Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Ideal/Lemmas.lean:1015 transports squarefreeness to the principal ideal; Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/AdicValuation.lean:261 converts that bound directly to the stated valuation inequality.
findings.fix: Transport hr using Ideal.squarefree_span_singleton.mpr, apply squarefree_iff_emultiplicity_le_one at v.asIdeal, exclude the unit branch using v.isPrime.ne_top and Ideal.isUnit_iff, then finish with v.exp_le_intValuation_iff_emultiplicity_le (n := 1).
findings.issue: The proof manually reconstructs the squarefree multiplicity bound through logarithms and a principal generator, duplicating existing library machinery.

summary: The general valuation theorem re-derives a bound already supplied by Mathlib's squarefree multiplicity and valuation comparison APIs.
